backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality including user profiles, product management, shopping cart, orders, Stripe integration, branding/homepage configuration, shop details, description templates, and access control with admin/user roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including marketplace filter tabs, description template management, and React Query hooks with associated test IDs and component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing marketplace with filter tabs, admin dashboard with seven tabs, bulk upload with template selector, product management, checkout flow with AUD pricing, and branding customization.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining design tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Original Creations Hub' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment success/failure, legal pages, and shopping basket, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dynamic branding hook and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview, progress tracking, and form validation using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, supporting auto-fill from templates, AI description generation, and batch processing with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing product description templates with name and content fields.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with create, edit, and delete functionality including confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying company info, legal links (terms/privacy), contact email, and attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings form for customizing homepage hero section including motto text, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header containing site logo/name, navigation (basket, dashboard), authentication button, and footer outlet.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, shape, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that uses the useAddToCart mutation hook and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product information with image, description, and actions for 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now' (which navigates to checkout).
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for managing products with inline editing of name, description, price, and images, plus inventory count adjustment with +/- buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that returns null; previously handled profile setup modal after login but is no longer active.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form for configuring shop details including name, contact information (email required), address, opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form for configuring Stripe payment integration by entering secret key and allowed country codes, with validation and mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that dynamically updates document title and favicon based on branding configuration from the backend, with fallbacks to defaults.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for all backend API calls including products, cart, user profiles, orders, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, homepage config, and description templates with mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart items or buy-now product, calculates totals, and creates Stripe checkout sessions with success/cancel URL handling.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates, showing statistics cards for inventory and product counts.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying hero section, featured products, most viewed, best selling, and newest products with filtering by shape/category and product detail modal view.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Displays a payment failure page with a red error icon, message explaining the payment couldn't be processed, and buttons to retry checkout or return to shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Displays a payment success confirmation page with a green checkmark icon, clears the shopping cart and buyNowProductId from session storage on mount, and provides a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders a static privacy policy page with sections covering information collection, usage, sharing, payment processing, data security, user rights, cookies, children's privacy, policy changes, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with product items, quantity controls (plus/minus buttons), remove functionality, and a checkout summary showing subtotal with a proceed-to-checkout button; shows empty state when cart is empty.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders a static terms and conditions page covering introduction, products/services, pricing/payment, shipping/delivery, returns/refunds, intellectual property, liability limitations, terms changes, and contact information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to store, retrieve, and clear parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, custom fonts (Inter and Crimson Pro), border radius variables, custom shadows, accordion animations, and includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an Artisan Hub marketplace application with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, Stripe payments, and product management features. Documents known issues including image persistence failures in bulk upload, broken Buy Now button, and authentication/checkout flow problems.
